replies.text: {"verdicts":[{"id":"T1","keep":true,"reason":"Unauthenticated queue plus card-charging payments agent supports spoofed planner messages causing fraudulent charges."},{"id":"T2","keep":true,"reason":"Distinct attack: prompt injection via supplier/itinerary text hijacking planner delegation to payments agent."},{"id":"T3","keep":false,"reason":"Same attacker influence on agent chain causing unauthorized card charges as T1; no distinct attack.","duplicateOf":"T1"},{"id":"T4","keep":true,"reason":"Modifying in-flight queue messages to alter amount/payee is a distinct attack from spoofing new messages."},{"id":"T5","keep":true,"reason":"Read access to unauthenticated queue disclosing itineraries and payment data is a distinct harm."},{"id":"T6","keep":true,"reason":"Flooding the writable unauthenticated queue stalls bookings and inflates cost; distinct availability harm."},{"id":"T7","keep":true,"reason":"Unattributable charges on a named payment flow block dispute/fraud investigation; specific, not generic."}]}
